raw:
That the decree was obtained by fraud, being contrary to Article 95 of the First Schedule of the Limitation Act 1908, which provides for setting aside a decree obtained by fraud.  

That the decree was procured through material misrepresentation and deceit, constituting the fraud contemplated by Article 95 of the Limitation Act 1908.  

That the summons was not duly served on the defendant, and the defendant was prevented by sufficient cause from appearing when the suit was called for hearing, as contemplated by Order IX Rule 13 of the CPC 1908, thereby entitling the defendant to an order setting aside the ex parte decree.  

That, in view of the fraud and misrepresentation, the Court is empowered under Order XXXVII Rule 4 of the CPC 1908 to set aside the decree and, if necessary, stay or set aside any execution thereon.

raw:
That the appeal has been filed twelve (12) days after the expiry of the period prescribed for filing such appeal under the Limitation Act 1908, and that the appellant seeks condonation of this delay.  

That the appellant was prosecuting a civil proceeding bona fide and with due diligence, which is founded upon the same cause of action as the present appeal; consequently, the period of delay is excluded under Section 14 of the Limitation Act 1908.  

That, in accordance with Order XLVII Rule 7 of the Code of Civil Procedure 1908, an order granting this application may be made notwithstanding the lapse of the limitation period, provided the court is satisfied that the delay was not due to any default or neglect on the part of the appellant.  

PRAYER  

The appellant prays that this Hon’ble Court may be pleased to:

a) Condone the twelve (12) day delay in filing the appeal; and  

b) Permit the appeal to be heard on its merits.

APPLICATION FOR DISCHARGE OF SURETY

That the applicant [NAME OF SURETY], being a surety for the bail bond of [NAME OF ACCUSED] executed under Section 499 CrPC 1898, hereby applies for discharge of the bond in accordance with Section 502 CrPC 1898.  

That the applicant has complied with all conditions imposed by the bond and there is no pending requirement for his security or attendance.  

That the applicant respectfully prays that this Hon’ble Court may be pleased to:

1. Issue an order discharging the applicant from the bail bond; and  

2. Direct the Magistrate to release the applicant from any further liability under the bond.
